title: Decision amending the Decision on Bank Reserve Requirement at the Central Bank of Montenegro
text:
Pursuant to Article 44 paragraph 2 point 3 and Article 18 of the Central Bank of Montenegro Law
(OGM 40/10, 6/13. 70/17, 125.23), at its meeting held on 31 July 2024, the Council of the Central
Bank of Montenegro passed the following
DECISION
amending the Decision on Bank Reserve Requirement at
the Central Bank of Montenegro
Article 1
In the Decision on Bank Reserve Requirement at the Central Bank of Montenegro (OGM
19/22) in Article 10, the words “€STR rate minus 10 basis points on annual basis until the
eighth calendar day in the current month for the previous month, provided that this rate
may not be lower than zero” shall be replaced with the words: ”0 (zero)”.
Article 2
This Decision shall enter into force on the eighth day following that of its publication in the
Official Gazette of Montenegro.
THE COUNCIL OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF MONTENEGRO
Decision number: 0101-5825- 7/2024
Podgorica, 31 July 2024
CHAIRPERSON,
G O V E R N O R
Irena Radović, m.p.
